connector.name: Liquibase Changelog MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Convert natural language into validated Liquibase XML or SQL changesets. 19 tools, 12 databases.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image liquibase-mcp-changelog-server:1.0.0. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the liquibase account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: LIQUIBASE_LICENSE_KEY
env.description: Liquibase Pro license key (required for server operation)

env.name: LIQUIBASE_MCP_OUTPUT_FORMAT
env.description: Output format for generated changesets: xml (default) or formatted-sql

env.name: LIQUIBASE_MCP_SQL_DATABASE
env.description: Target database dialect for Formatted SQL output (postgresql, mysql, mariadb, oracle, mssql, h2, db2, sybase, sqlite, hsqldb, derby, firebird)

env.name: LIQUIBASE_MCP_DISABLE_VALIDATION
env.description: Skip H2 in-memory database validation of generated changesets

env.name: LIQUIBASE_MCP_INCLUDE_ROLLBACK
env.description: Generate explicit rollback blocks in XML changesets
